doc: Fitted to the 2026-10-02 trace of DiskANN PQFlashIndex (diskannpy 0.7.0): SIFT1M, degree 64, search list 100, beam 4, 10,000 nodes cached by breadth-first levels, 1,000 queries from 1 thread. Its CPU is 0.5 ms a query, the user time measured on the traces (0.46 to 0.62 ms; DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.50), not fitted per case, and `near` the uncached trace's (the same index; a node cache skips those rounds).
